preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.
Each edge connects two vertices within the tree.
No self-loops or multiple edges are present.
The given edges form a single, connected graph without cycles.

postconditions.expression: output[i] is the dominant index of vertex i
postconditions.description: For each vertex i, output[i] is the index j such that for all k < j, d_{i, k} < d_{i, j}, and for all k > j, d_{i, k} ≤ d_{i, j}.
